app.name: Zero to Hero
app.tagline: Build a study trail, break it into milestones and tick them off one by one.

landing.title: From zero to hero, one milestone at a time
landing.lede: For a certification, a new language or a career shift. Use it alone or with friends.

create.title: Create a trail
create.body: Give it a name, a goal and, if you like, a date. Start from scratch or copy someone's template.

split.title: Break it into milestones
split.body: Group milestones into phases. Each milestone is something you can finish.

tick.title: Tick them off
tick.body: Attach evidence when you finish: a link, a note or the certificate.

share.title: Share
share.body: Publish your trail as a template, follow friends and cheer them on.

tracks.title: My trails
tracks.empty: No trails yet. Create your first one.
